adds.title: Corbitt v. Taylor
adds.summary: Alabama requires transgender people to have undergone certain gender-affirming surgery to change the gender marker on a driver license, meaning most transgender people cannot obtain an accurate license and must use daily ID showing the wrong gender exposing them to high risk of harassment and violence, and on September 20, 2024 the Eleventh Circuit Court of Appeals ruled that refusal to issue accurate licenses did not violate the federal constitution, with rehearing denied November 13, 2024 and judgment entered December 10, 2024 leaving the surgery requirement in place.
